description: This file defines Django form handling and web request handlers for managing contact data, including adding, editing, deleting contacts, and handling contact avatars, within a Google App Engine environment.

classes.name: BaseRequestHandler
classes.description: A base class for request handlers providing form rendering helper functions.

classes.name: ContactForm
classes.description: A Django ModelForm for the Contact model.

classes.name: ContactInsertPage
classes.description: Handles adding new contacts via GET (form display) and POST (save).

classes.name: ContactEditPage
classes.description: Handles editing existing contacts via GET (populate form) and POST (save updates).

classes.name: AvatarEditPage
classes.description: Handles editing a contact's avatar image.

classes.name: AvatarViewPage
classes.description: Serves the contact's avatar image or default if none exists.

classes.name: ContactsListPage
classes.description: Displays a list of all contacts.

methods.name: send_form
methods.description: Renders a form page with specified parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests for various pages (add, edit, delete, avatar, list).

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles POST requests for form submissions (add, edit, avatar update).

methods.name: main
methods.description: Sets up URL routing and runs the WSGI application.
